Title: Everything is SUPER with the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce GTX SUPER Series | ZOTAC
URL: https://www.zotac.com/us/news/everything-super-zotac-gaming-geforce-gtx-super-series
Published: 2019-10-08T03:41:42.000Z
Author: N/A
Highlights:
HONG KONG – October 29, 2019 - ZOTAC Technology, a global manufacturer of innovation, is pleased to expand the GeForce® GTX line of graphics cards with the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce® GTX SUPER™ series featuring GDDR6 ultra-fast memory.

...

Powered by the new NVIDIA Turing™ GPU architecture, the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce® GTX 1660 SUPER™ series feature two super compact VR ready models and is up to 20% faster than the original GTX 1660 and up to 1.5X faster than the previous-generation GTX 1060 6GB.

...

The Full 1660 SUPER

For those wanting the GeForce® GTX 1660 SUPER™ without the additional enhancements, the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce® GTX 1660 SUPER™ Twin Fan brings all the SUPER performance. Featuring a full body length aluminum array heatsink with a dual offset 70mm and 80mm fans. One fan focuses on optimizing static pressure to increase airflow staying power where the larger focuses on maximizing airflow. Measuring at a super compact 173.4mm or 6.83 inches, the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER Twin Fan is the smallest in the lineup ready to power the smallest of ITX builds.

The 1650 SUPER

The ZOTAC GAMING GeForce® GTX 1650 SUPER™ series feature up to 50% faster than the original GTX 1650 and up to 2X faster performance than the previous-generation GTX 1050. The 1650 SUPER™ Twin Fan brings all the SUPER performance featuring a full body length aluminum array heatsink with dual 70mm fans. Measuring at a super compact 158.5mm or 6.24 inches, the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce GTX 1650 SUPER Twin Fan feature a HDMI 2.0b, DisplayPort 1.4, and a dual-link DVI connector to power up to 3 displays.
